result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major content typo in the search placeholder and a minor layout issue with truncated content in the restaurant list.

issues.description: Typo in the search bar placeholder text: 'Restarants' is missing an 'u' and should be 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the spelling to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off on the right edge, showing 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of the full name.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal scroll container or card width to ensure full names are visible or implement an ellipsis for long names.
